title: Drift King Shutokou Battle '97: Tsuchiya Keiichi & Bandou Masaaki (Demo)
overview:
New Limited Ver.97

Keiichi Tsuchiya, Masaaki Bandoh in Syutokoh Battle '97

Supervised by racing driver Keiichi Tsuchiya and car tuner Masaaki Bandoh. Experience realistic public-road battles and drifting, built with an abundance of polygons.

Shutokou Battle '97 is a street racing game set on Tokyo's elevated expressways at night. Pick a car, choose a course such as the outer loop of the inner circular route, and go door to door with a rival - the first to complete the laps wins.

Between races, visit Bandoh's garage to buy parts and adjust your car's settings, then take it back out on the highway to prove what it can do.

This disc is a demo version of the game.

- 1 player
- Rival battles on expressway courses
- Car tuning with parts and settings
- Racing controller support

NEW LIMITED VER.97

KEIICHI TSUCHIYA,MASAAKI BANDOH IN SYUTOKOH BATTLE' 97

レーシングドライバー土屋圭市とカーチューナー坂東正明が監修。ポリゴンをふんだんに使用した実車さながらの公道バトル、ドリフトの疑似体験ができる。
